summary: SkinHealth Systems Inc. filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, reporting the September 30, 2026 full repayment of the remaining $103,235,000 principal of its 1.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2026, plus $645,218.75 accrued interest, under the September 14, 2021 indenture with U.S. Bank as trustee. The indenture was satisfied and discharged, releasing the company from remaining obligations except surviving provisions. This is a routine debt retirement, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors were disclosed. Watch for any follow-on convertible issuance or liquidity commentary.
